name: sidebar
title: Sidebar
description: Collapsible labeled primary navigation shell with configurable chrome, search, groups, workspace switcher, and account menu.

api.description: Collapsible labeled primary navigation shell. Compose Header, Search, Content, Nav, Group, Item, Workspace, User, Separator, Shortcut, and CollapseTrigger. Prefer Tool Rail for icon mode switching and Dock Panel for persistent inspectors. Chrome is tokenized via --df-sidebar-* and semantic --sidebar*.

groups.title: Sidebar
groups.description: Root landmark. Controllable collapsed width. Pass chrome props or set the matching CSS variables on style. Parts must render inside this root.

props.name: onCollapsedChange
props.description: Called when the collapsed state changes.

props.name: side
props.description: Intended edge. Collapsed tooltips open away from the shell (right for left side, left for right side).

props.name: width
props.description: Expanded width. Prefer tokens such as var(--df-sidebar-width). Sets --df-sidebar-width.

props.name: collapsedWidth
props.description: Collapsed width. Prefer tokens such as var(--df-sidebar-width-collapsed). Sets --df-sidebar-width-collapsed.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the shell. Maps to --df-sidebar-radius.

props.name: itemRadius
props.description: Corner radius for items and triggers. Maps to --df-sidebar-item-radius.

props.name: cornerShape
props.description: Instance corner curve. Omit to inherit --df-corner-shape from the theme (set at create/init).

props.name: borderColor
props.description: Shell border color. Prefer var(--sidebar-border). Sets --df-sidebar-border.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the landmark and for collapse controls when aria-label is omitted.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Overrides label on the aside landmark. Collapse controls still use label unless you set their aria-label.

props.name: children
props.description: Compose Header, Search, Content, Footer, CollapseTrigger, and related parts.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the aside root.

props.name: …aside attributes
props.description: Native aside attributes on the root.

groups.title: SidebarHeader
groups.description: Top region for workspace switcher, search, and collapse.

props.name: …div attributes
props.description: Native div attributes on the header.

groups.title: SidebarContent
groups.description: Scrollable middle region. Wraps children in ScrollArea.

props.name: children
props.description: Typically SidebarNav with groups and items.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the content shell.

props.name: …div attributes
props.description: Native div attributes on the content shell.

groups.title: SidebarFooter
groups.description: Bottom region for utility items and account menu.

props.name: children
props.description: Typically SidebarItem rows, Separator, and SidebarUser.

props.name: …div attributes
props.description: Native div attributes on the footer.

groups.title: SidebarNav
groups.description: Semantic nav stack for primary destinations and groups.

groups.title: SidebarSearch
groups.description: Expanded mode composes SearchInput. Collapsed mode shows an icon control with a tooltip. onClick runs for both modes so a command palette or focus handoff can share one handler.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Trailing shortcut chip when expanded. Rendered with SidebarShortcut.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Show the clear control when the field has a value.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Click handler for the expanded input and the collapsed icon control.

props.name: …SearchInput props
props.description: value, defaultValue, onChange, disabled, and related field props. trailing is owned by shortcut.

groups.title: SidebarGroup
groups.description: Section with optional label and action. Header is omitted while the sidebar is collapsed.

props.name: label
props.description: Section heading via ListItemLabel nav variant.

props.name: action
props.description: Optional control beside the label, such as an add button.

props.name: …div attributes
props.description: Native div attributes on the group.

groups.title: SidebarItem
groups.description: Composes ListItem with muted variant and sm size. Collapsed mode keeps the label for accessibility, hides it visually, and shows a tooltip.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading glyph. Ignored when swatch is set.

props.name: swatch
props.description: Leading color swatch. Prefer a kit color token such as var(--df-teal-400).

props.name: badge
props.description: Optional badge on the icon, such as a count.

props.name: active
props.description: Selected row state. Maps to ListItem selected.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Merge row props onto a single child element, usually a link.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Extra trailing content before the shortcut.

props.name: children
props.description: Row label. Also used for aria-label and collapsed tooltip text.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the ListItem host.

groups.title: SidebarShortcut
groups.description: Trailing keyboard hint chrome. Used by SidebarSearch and SidebarItem; can also be composed manually.

groups.title: SidebarSeparator
groups.description: Divider between nav blocks. Composes Separator.

props.name: decorative
props.description: When true, omits separator semantics for assistive tech.

groups.title: SidebarWorkspace
groups.description: Workspace switcher host. Wraps OptionList. Compose SidebarWorkspaceTrigger, SidebarWorkspaceContent, and OptionListItem rows.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when the selected workspace changes.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the menu opens or closes.

props.name: width
props.description: OptionList width mode for the trigger and panel.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the workspace host.

props.name: …OptionList props
props.description: selectionMode, closeOnSelect, and related picker props.

groups.title: SidebarWorkspaceTrigger
groups.description: Opens the workspace menu. Collapsed mode shows the logo with a tooltip.

props.name: title
props.description: Workspace name. Required. Used for aria-label and tooltip text.

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary plan or meta line when expanded.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the trigger button.

groups.title: SidebarWorkspaceContent
groups.description: Portaled OptionList panel. Place OptionListItem rows and related OptionList parts inside.

props.name: side
props.description: Preferred panel side. Defaults to right when the shell is left, and left when the shell is right.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Gap from the trigger in pixels.

props.name: portal
props.description: Render the panel in a portal.

props.name: search
props.description: Show the built-in OptionList search field.

props.name: children
props.description: OptionListItem rows and related list parts.

props.name: …OptionListContent props
props.description: alignOffset, dismissOnScroll, scrollable, footer, and related panel props.

groups.title: SidebarUser
groups.description: Account menu host. Wraps Popover. Compose SidebarUserTrigger and SidebarUserContent.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the popover opens or closes.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the user host.

groups.title: SidebarUserTrigger
groups.description: Opens the account menu. Collapsed mode shows the avatar with a tooltip.

props.name: name
props.description: Display name. Required. Used for aria-label, tooltip, and Avatar name when string.

props.name: src
props.description: Avatar image URL for the default Avatar.

props.name: avatar
props.description: Custom avatar node. Replaces the default Avatar.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the trigger button.

groups.title: SidebarUserContent
groups.description: Portaled Popover panel. Compose PopoverHeader, PopoverBody, PopoverFooter, ListItem rows, and related content.

props.name: side
props.description: Preferred panel side. Defaults to right when the shell is left, and left when the shell is right.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Gap from the trigger in pixels.

props.name: …PopoverContent props
props.description: variant, size, radius, portal, and related panel props.

groups.title: SidebarCollapseTrigger
groups.description: Toggles collapsed state on the surrounding Sidebar. Renders as a ghost icon-sm Button.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional icon. Defaults to PanelLeft when children are omitted.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name. Defaults to Expand {label} or Collapse {label}.

props.name: title
props.description: Native title. Defaults to the same string as aria-label.

props.name: …Button props
props.description: Additional button attributes. size and variant default to icon-sm and ghost.

groups.title: Tokens
groups.description: Theme defaults live on :root. Override these globally or on a local host.

props.name: --df-sidebar-item-gap
props.description: Gap between rows in a group.

props.name: --df-sidebar-group-label-fg
props.description: Group action and label quiet color.

props.name: --df-corner-shape
props.description: Theme corner curve for all kit chrome. round = circular arcs; smooth = continuous squircle. Set with df-ui init --corner-shape, or override on :root. Default round.
